description: A small stack of colorful plates sits on a green cloth near the corner of a wall and a white panel. The left hand reaches in from the right, touches the top yellow plate as a left-hand object, lifts it up and moves it to the right to set it down, then slides the blue plate forward to the left, lifts the red plate off the remaining stack to reveal a green plate, and places the red plate down in front so the plates end up unstacked and spread out.
